_about: 法术试炼 — 手势斗法 played whole, a test field in the 游戏厅 (doc/games.md § 手势斗法, Hanli 10-21: 「OK, 你写进文档, 然后可以开始做了」): beasts walk down three lanes toward 小满; the player's hands throw every tier — 小招 (a shape + a jab or a push), 法术 (文 → 扣 → push), 大招 (the four seals) — paid from the 灵力 bar; the 五行 combos show. The moves' numbers are jieyin.json `doufa`; this file is the field. Camera only (no camera → one line). 游戏厅 only; not in the story.
_field: games/doufa/field.js: a beast every `spawn.everyMs` (± `jitter`, at most `max` on the field) in a random lane, a kind from `foes` by weight (`hp`, `speed` in field heights a second, `element`); the 大妖 (`boss`) steps out at `boss.at` s and fills the 灵力 (jieyin.json doufa.lingli.boss). A 土墙 holds its lane at `wallY`; a beast past `goalY` got by (counted, nothing lost — a trial). Stars: beasts down by `seconds` at `stars`.

lead.zh: 野兽顺着三条道往下走。手放在哪一边，招就打哪一路：剑诀一戳是飞剑，推掌一推是掌风；掐文、握拳扣住、往前一拍是法术；四印结成，火蛋自己飞。
lead.en: Beasts walk down three lanes. Where your hand stands is the lane you hit: jab a sword seal for a flying sword, push a palm for palm wind; press a mark, close the fist, push — a spell; make the four seals and the fire egg flies by itself.
